_comment: ETPH Pro one-time product (owner decision 2026-10-20). Created INACTIVE by ci/play-iap.js (tag set-play-iap-<n>). The script never sets a live price or activates anything: the owner sets the price and activates the purchase option in Play Console. proposedPriceUsd is only used if Play refuses a product without any purchase-option price, and then only on a DRAFT purchase option.

listings.title: ETPH Pro
listings.description: Unlocks Wi-Fi and Bluetooth sharing, routers, several computers and routers, auto-start and auto-reconnect, and data usage history. One-time purchase, no subscription.
